Title.description: Heading shown above the carousel; also used as the page title and the carousel's accessible name

Subtitle.description: Optional line shown under the heading; leave empty to hide it

Slide1Image.description: URL of the image for slide 1; leave empty to skip this slide

Slide1Alt.description: Alternative text describing the image for slide 1

Slide1Caption.description: Optional caption shown under the image for slide 1; leave empty to hide it

Slide2Image.description: URL of the image for slide 2; leave empty to skip this slide

Slide2Alt.description: Alternative text describing the image for slide 2

Slide2Caption.description: Optional caption shown under the image for slide 2; leave empty to hide it

Slide3Image.description: URL of the image for slide 3; leave empty to skip this slide

Slide3Alt.description: Alternative text describing the image for slide 3

Slide3Caption.description: Optional caption shown under the image for slide 3; leave empty to hide it

Slide4Image.description: URL of the image for slide 4; leave empty to skip this slide

Slide4Alt.description: Alternative text describing the image for slide 4

Slide4Caption.description: Optional caption shown under the image for slide 4; leave empty to hide it

Slide5Image.description: URL of the image for slide 5; leave empty to skip this slide

Slide5Alt.description: Alternative text describing the image for slide 5

Slide5Caption.description: Optional caption shown under the image for slide 5; leave empty to hide it

Slide6Image.description: URL of the image for slide 6; leave empty to skip this slide

Slide6Alt.description: Alternative text describing the image for slide 6

Slide6Caption.description: Optional caption shown under the image for slide 6; leave empty to hide it

Slide7Image.description: URL of the image for slide 7; leave empty to skip this slide

Slide7Alt.description: Alternative text describing the image for slide 7

Slide7Caption.description: Optional caption shown under the image for slide 7; leave empty to hide it

Slide8Image.description: URL of the image for slide 8; leave empty to skip this slide

Slide8Alt.description: Alternative text describing the image for slide 8

Slide8Caption.description: Optional caption shown under the image for slide 8; leave empty to hide it

Direction.description: Reading direction of the carousel: rtl for Arabic, ltr for English

Language.description: Language code of the content, for example ar or en

Autoplay.description: Whether the carousel moves to the next slide on its own

IntervalSeconds.description: Seconds between slides when autoplay is on, for example 5

AccentColor.description: Colour of the active dot and arrow hover as a CSS colour, for example #b8945a

PreviousLabel.description: Screen-reader label for the previous arrow, for example الشريحة السابقة

NextLabel.description: Screen-reader label for the next arrow, for example الشريحة التالية

SlideLabel.description: Screen-reader word placed before each dot's number, for example الشريحة
